rationale: DESeq2 on raw counts for an unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch design fits, and the sample_01 sensitivity rerun is a sensible policy, but the QC omits PCA and sample-distance inspection colored by condition. No low-count filter is stated at all, the design formula and reference level are never written out, and no fold-change shrinkage (apeglm) is planned; the |log2FC| cutoff is applied post hoc rather than in the test. Enrichment correctly uses the mouse Hallmark collection with a stated Wald-statistic ranking, but gives no collection version or set-size window and is internally inconsistent (48 vs 50 sets). The report lacks package versions and an explicit model statement.
